name: What types of materials are available for bathroom vanities and cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are available for bathroom vanities and cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: A variety of materials are available for bathroom vanities and cabinets, each with unique characteristics. Common options include solid wood, plywood, MDF (medium-density fiberboard), and particleboard. Solid wood offers durability and a classic look, while plywood is a stable and water-resistant choice. MDF and particleboard are more budget-friendly and can be finished with laminates or veneers to mimic the look of more expensive materials. We can help you select the best option for your budget and aesthetic preferences.
